Overview

Cusco is a city in CU with a population of 500,000. The historic capital of the Inca Empire, a UNESCO World Heritage city and gateway to Machu Picchu. Housing is notably more expensive than the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 6a growing zone supports Cool to mild — apples, pears, berries, many vegetables. The population skews young, with a median age of 30.0.
